reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing chat utility that automates prompt rewriting inside the DSH input box by adding a one-click ✨ action to call an LLM and optionally restore the original draft, which classifies it as automation; supporting details in the package manifest and README show a web client extension plus host route for model requests.

summaries.zh: 该插件在DSH聊天输入框右侧提供✨按钮，可调用内置或外部LLM对当前草稿进行一键优化，并支持再次点击恢复原文。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a ✨ button to the DSH chat input area to optimize the current draft with built-in or external LLMs in one click, with a second click to restore the original text.

reasons.code: README documents a ⭐ button in the chat input area that optimizes the current draft via LLM and writes the result back to inputActions.setDraft.
README describes a host-side /prompt-optimize/api route plus OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic provider request paths, indicating outbound model API traffic through external endpoints.
README notes external API Key/Base URL are stored in browser localStorage and forwarded with requests, which involves credential handling and network transmission of user text.
